programs: Each program the line runs, in the order they start, as the programs it runs behind and then itself, joined by >.
caught: true: the hook routes the line through may-i; false: it lets the line through, because nothing in it reaches 1Password outside may-i, or (for the cases named as known limits) because the lexer cannot see it.
